ShelfSort benennt Filme und Serien so, w: ShelfSort names movies and TV shows the way Plex expects, moves them into your library and keeps episode numbers in line with the episode order set in Plex.
ShelfSort sucht die Ordner selbst und pr: ShelfSort finds the folders itself and checks them against real files from Plex (the server may see a different path, e.g. /data/movies, than this computer, e.g. X:\Media\movies). For each type, one library is the default for new imports; new episodes of existing shows always go to their show.
